title: Guidelines for School Health Services: Oral Health
before:
Schools and school nurses can play a role in enhancing children's oral health. Through education, screening, and preventative care we can improve oral health for all people in Maine. 

  • Maine Center for Disease Control & Prevention: Oral Health in Schools 
  • The Children's Oral Health Network of Maine has collaborated with school nurses and other partners to create a toolkit. Visit Bringing Oral Health Care into Schools & Community Settings to find the School-Based Oral Health Toolkit: A Resource for School Nurses.
  • American Academy of Pediatrics recognizes the role of schools in oral health and outlines the components of an effective school-based program. 
  • US CDC: Oral Health in Schools
  • Oral Health: Tips for Families from the National Center on Early Childhood Health and Wellness

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 2 links on this page open a file — 2 PDF — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Separate a link from its description
decisions.why: 1 list item opens with a link and then explain it, all at the same weight — so the thing you can click is no easier to find than the sentence about it. The link becomes the item and the explanation sits under it.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: Schools and school nurses can play a role in enhancing children's oral health. Through education, screening, and preventative care we can improve oral health for all people in Maine.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
decisions.why: It repeats the page title in picture form, which the new banner already does in type.
decisions.removes: School Health - Oral Health Web Banner.png

decisions.label: Start a description with a capital
decisions.why: 1 description begins with a small letter, because it used to run on from the link after a dash. The dash is gone and the link now sits above in its own face, so each description opens a line of its own. One character changes and only ever the first.
